subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@atlas-payments.com>, Tom Reed <t.reed@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Hi Sara / Tom 

Thanks again for the demo this morning 


- really appreciated the context on your chargeback flow and the ML evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I put together an initial POC plan and proposed success criteria so we can align on scope and expectations before the kickoff. Attached is a one-page plan (redwood-poc-plan.pdf).

High-level POC goal
- Validate that Redwood can meet Atlas Payments' latency, throughput, cost and quality targets on a realistic sample of your traffic, and produce output that fits into your post-processing pipeline.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs (please confirm):
- Latency: p50 <= 200 ms, p95 <= 400 ms (in-region, measured at edge before network egress)
- Throughput: sustained 20 requests/sec with 100 concurrent sessions (burst to 60rps)
- Cost: average inference cost <= $0.0006 per token (estimate based on expected tokenization; we'll provide a detailed cost model)
- Quality: accuracy >= 92% on labeled holdout for classification/labeling tasks OR an agreed-on quality rubric for open-generation cases; hallucination rate < 2% on sampled outputs

Evaluation plan / measurables
- Atlas provides a labeled sample dataset (anonymized) and a production-like traffic profile (token distributions).
- Redwood will spin up a sandbox endpoint (hosted/dedicated or VPC per your preference) and provide a test harness for load testing and metric capture.
- We will run: (1) functional quality evaluation on holdout labels, (2) synthetic load tests for throughput/latency for 48 hours, (3) cost simulation based on 7-day sample traffic.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): confirm success criteria, sign mutual action plan, share sample dataset and security checklist.
- Week 1: Redwood provision sandbox, run initial smoke tests, and run functional quality evaluation.
- Week 2: Full load tests, cost simulation, and final review with Atlas stakeholders.

Ownership / next steps
- Atlas: provide anonymized sample dataset, list of participants for kickoff, and expected daily volumes (tokens/day).
- Redwood (Marissa): finalize MPA and kickoff scheduling; (Connor) to run technical setup and lead SE work.
- Procurement: we can provide a short-term trial agreement and a simple SOW if needed.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB)

Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the proposed 2-week POC timeline works for you? Happy to adjust based on your constraints.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@atlas-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <t.reed@atlas-payments.com>, procurement@atlas-payments.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Thanks Marissa 

This looks good and very thorough. A few quick clarifications before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Dataset: we can provide a 7-10k anonymized sample set of historical disputes and associated metadata by EOD Thursday. Is CSV + JSON payloads OK?
2) VPC/Private deployment: security is important for us. Can Redwood run the POC inside our VPC or offer a private deployment option for the trial? We need to understand what data leaves our network.
3) Cost question: the team expects ~2M tokens/day for our pilot traffic. Can you provide a rough estimate of daily inference cost using your $/token KPI? Also, do you include embedding or downstream processing costs?
4) Compliance: please send your SOC 2 cert and data retention policy. Procurement will need a short-term agreement to pilot.

If the timeline stays the same, we can aim for the kickoff next week (Wed/Thu) - I'll confirm once Procurement checks availability.

--
Sara Patel
Head of ML Ops, Atlas Payments
sara.patel@atlas-payments.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@atlas-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Sara - thanks for the quick reply. Short answers to your questions and some implementation notes: 

1) Dataset format: CSV + JSON payloads are fine. We prefer a CSV index with a JSON column for the raw payloads. Please remove any PII; if needed we can run a joint anonymization step.

2) VPC/private: yes - we support both hosted sandbox and a VPC-based private trial. For VPC we will need a couple of IP ranges and a temporary IAM role to pull artifacts; I'll attach our SE onboarding doc. If you need an on-prem agent, we can discuss that but it will add a week to provisioning.

3) Cost estimate: using the proposed $0.0006/token and 2M tokens/day, rough inference-only cost would be ~$1,200/day. This is + any optional embedding/feature extraction costs; we can break this into per-call components in the cost model. We'll provide a cost spreadsheet during the kickoff.

4) Measurements & test harness:
- Latency: measure p50/p95 at the client-side (test harness) with cold starts disabled for steady-state; note that KV cache warmup can affect early p95s.
- Throughput: run a 48-hour sustained test with ramp and two 1-hour stress bursts to validate autoscaling behavior.
- Quality: we'll run a labeled evaluation and provide confusion matrices and sample output for manual review.

Attached: poc-harness-instructions.md (text/markdown, 8 KB) and link to security packet: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/security/atlas-security-packet.pdf

Happy to run a quick technical pre-kickoff with your infra team if helpful.

--
Connor Obrien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Next steps:
- Sara / Tom: please confirm dataset delivery (CSV+JSON) and whether you prefer Hosted sandbox or VPC trial.
- Procurement: I'll share a short pilot SOW and trial agreement for signature; please let us know the correct contact.
- Proposed kickoff: Wednesday 2026-09-02 at 10:00 AM PT (30-45m). Agenda: intros, final scope, security checklist, milestone dates. Can you confirm availability?

If that works I'll send a calendar invite and attach the SOW stub.

Best,
